roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Banking customer risk and transaction intelligence: modeling transaction behavior, preparing large financial datasets and reporting risk KPIs to business teams.
highlights: Developed XGBoost models in Python to analyze 250K+ banking transactions, identifying unusual transaction behavior and customer activity patterns for risk assessment.
Processed 500K+ financial records with PySpark, performing data cleansing, transformation and aggregation to prepare reliable datasets for machine learning workflows.
Created 10+ behavioral features with SQL and performed feature engineering and variable selection across 15+ candidate attributes for predictive modeling.
Evaluated 5+ model iterations through hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation, and tracked 8+ model experiments in MLflow for reproducible development.
Developed Power BI reporting covering 12+ financial and risk KPIs to monitor transaction activity, customer behavior and portfolio trends.
Validated model outputs against business rules and historical patterns, and presented findings to stakeholders in monthly risk and transaction reviews.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.description: Consumer credit and customer segmentation analytics across credit and financing portfolios.
highlights: Analyzed 200K+ consumer account records using Python and SQL to identify customer behavior patterns across credit and financing portfolios.
Applied K-Means clustering on 10+ behavioral features to develop 4 customer segments for segmentation and portfolio analysis.
Developed Logistic Regression models across 4+ iterations to analyze customer payment behavior and the factors associated with customer outcomes.
Performed hypothesis testing and A/B analysis across 2 customer groups, providing statistical evidence for differences in customer response and behavior.
Built ARIMA forecasting models on 18+ months of historical data to analyze transaction-volume and customer-activity trends for portfolio planning.
Developed Tableau dashboards covering 10+ portfolio KPIs, combining customer segments, account activity and transaction trends.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.description: Client data analytics and predictive modeling support, working with senior data scientists and client stakeholders.
highlights: Reviewed and standardized 10K+ client records by identifying duplicate, incomplete and inconsistent data, improving overall data quality by 8%.
Created reporting views covering 4+ business KPIs, helping senior team members monitor customer trends and reducing manual reporting effort by approximately 7%.
Validated client information across multiple sources and prepared 2+ analysis-ready datasets for reporting and business review.
Organized client information into 3+ analytical groups, making it easier for teams to identify relevant business patterns.
Supported 2+ project iterations by clarifying requirements, validating findings and incorporating feedback into analytical deliverables.

roles.title: Business Analyst
roles.description: Insurance operations and customer analytics: requirements, reporting and data review for policy and customer service processes.
highlights: Used Excel and SQL to review 10K+ policy and customer records, identifying missing information, duplicate entries and data inconsistencies.
Prepared recurring reports covering policy activity, customer requests and operational KPIs to help business teams monitor day-to-day insurance operations.
Supported UAT by preparing test cases, validating application results against requirements and documenting 10+ defects.
Maintained BRD/FRD documentation, process flows and requirement trackers, coordinating with business users, QA and IT teams.
Assisted with gathering and documenting requirements for insurance policy and customer service processes.
